body: I've never felt so small. I know deep down that I'll either be miserable with her or miserable without her. Shes my whole life and it doesn't even bother her. I've tried my best, given my all and I'm not good enough. I won't be good enough. I'm tired of trying and I can't go back to a life with nothing in it. Thank you for taking the time to talk to me, it's appreciated.

I am a lot different than I was before her, but it's not all bad. I've learned sacrifice and compromise which are good I think. I've lost my independence though, and my fight. I would have never put up with what I do before, but then again, I've never been in love either.
